subject: Solastics onboarding: TIN attestation and evidence needed to clear PO
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@solastics.io>, Accounts Payable <accounts@solastics.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Solastics onboarding: TIN attestation and evidence needed to clear PO

Hi Anna / Solastics AP team,

Thanks for completing the initial onboarding form — we're close to creating a PO, but our tax verification step flagged a TIN mismatch between the W-8BEN-E you uploaded and public tax records. To move forward with PO creation (we typically issue PO + 30-day payment terms once tax identity is validated) we need one of the following pieces of evidence that ties your legal entity name to the Tax Identification Number you provided: 

- A scanned official government registration showing the company TIN (issued within the last 3 years)
- An IRS Letter 147C (if you have US TIN history)
- A notarized company certificate or notarized W-8BEN-E with apostille (for non-US entities)
- VAT registration certificate showing the same TIN and legal name (EU vendors)

Also please confirm the authorized signatory name on the W-8BEN-E matches the person on your bank account and provide a short signatory proof (e.g., passport or corporate signatory page).

I attached our vendor-onboarding-checklist to make this easier. If you can upload the documents to the secure upload link below or reply to this thread with attachments, procurement will validate and queue PO-creation.

Secure upload: https://redwoodinference-secure.upload/solastics/147c

Next steps from our side: once documents are validated we will create PO-2029-0031 and confirm routing for the first invoice.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we have a small initial engagement planned and would like to get billing in place this month.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@solastics.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Tessa / all,

Thanks for the heads up — attaching the signed W-8BEN-E we completed and our company registration certificate.

Attachment: W-8BEN-E_Solastics_signed.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Company_Reg_Solastics_2028.jpg (image/jpeg)

Our finance team confirms the TIN we provided is 987654321 and that both the W-8 and registration certificate list the same TIN. If you still see a mismatch on your side, please let us know what specific name/TIN pairing caused the flag and we can request the 147C or a notarized copy.

We can also provide a notarized power-of-attorney for the signatory if that helps speed things up.

Best regards,
Anna Kovacs
Head of Finance Operations | Solastics Ltd.
anna.kovacs@solastics.io
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@solastics.io>, Accounts Payable <accounts@solastics.io>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-13T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solastics onboarding: TIN attestation and evidence needed to clear PO

Hi Anna — thanks for sending those. Quick note on why the verification failed: our backend crosschecks submitted TINs against a third-party global tax directory and the match confidence for 987654321 / "Solastics Ltd." came back low due to a formatting variation in the registration doc (alternate legal name on older certificate).

To close the loop we need one of these (any one will do):
- IRS Letter 147C confirming the TIN (if you have US tax filing history)
- A notarized company certificate or notarized W-8BEN-E with apostille
- An updated company registration showing the current legal name + TIN (PDF)

Also please confirm the signatory on the attached W-8 ("Anna Kovacs") is the same person on the bank account used for payment, and provide a copy of the signatory's passport or government ID page. For EU vendors we can accept VAT registration + a recent bank statement that shows the company name and account (redact account number if needed).

If you can upload the documents to the secure link (see Tessa's note), we'll validate and either clear the PO or, if there's still a discrepancy, issue a conditional PO for 50% of the first invoice amount while the evidence process completes. That will let the engagement start while we finish compliance checks.

Doc upload: https://redwoodinference-secure.upload/solastics/147c

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Karthik Iyer
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@solastics.io>

Thanks — we've requested an official IRS Letter 147C from our US filing agent and attached a notarized power-of-attorney and scanned ID for the signatory in the meantime so you can proceed with verification. We'll upload the 147C as soon as it arrives (estimate 3-5 business days).

Attachment: Notarized_POA_Solastics.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Signatory_passport_AnnaKovacs_redacted.pdf (application/pdf)

We'll also upload everything to your secure portal in the next 24 hours. Please let us know if a conditional PO for 50% is acceptable while the 147C is outstanding.

Best,
Anna
